title: Developer docs AEO readiness
description: Structural Answer Engine Optimization checks for developer documentation. Scores how well coding agents can find, read, and act on docs (retrieval path). Not Google SEO.

categories.title: Discoverability
categories.description: Agents can find the right entry points.

checks.title: Add an llms.txt file
checks.howToFix: Put a file at /llms.txt that lists your main docs pages with a short title and link for each.

checks.title: Keep llms.txt short enough
checks.howToFix: Keep llms.txt under about 100,000 characters so AI tools can read it easily.

checks.title: Fix broken links in llms.txt
checks.howToFix: Open the links in llms.txt and make sure they load. Remove or fix any dead links.

checks.title: Publish an agent skills list
checks.howToFix: Add /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json so tools can find your skills in one place.

checks.title: Make skill files open correctly
checks.howToFix: Each skill in your index should open a real skill.md page with a clear name and short description.

checks.title: Explain how to connect MCP
checks.howToFix: Add a simple docs page that shows how to connect your docs MCP in Cursor or Claude.

checks.title: Share your OpenAPI file
checks.howToFix: Publish openapi.json (or similar) and link it from your docs or llms.txt.

categories.title: Readability
categories.description: Agents can extract answers from fetched content.

checks.title: Offer Markdown versions of pages
checks.howToFix: Let each docs page also load as .md, or publish an llms-full.txt file AI tools can read.

checks.title: Put answers in the page HTML
checks.howToFix: Make sure key how-to steps appear in the page source, not only after JavaScript loads.

checks.title: Give each page one clear job
checks.howToFix: Use one main heading and a short intro. Keep each page focused on one task.

checks.title: Add copy-paste code samples
checks.howToFix: On key how-to pages, add install commands or API examples people can copy.

checks.title: List common mistakes
checks.howToFix: Add a short “common mistakes” or “outdated info” section so AI tools do not repeat old advice.

checks.title: Don’t block docs in robots.txt
checks.howToFix: In robots.txt, avoid blocking your whole site with Disallow: /.

categories.title: Actability
categories.description: Agents can complete tasks, not only read.

checks.title: Turn on a live MCP endpoint
checks.howToFix: Host a working docs MCP endpoint (often at /mcp) and mention it in your docs.

checks.title: Add step-by-step agent skills
checks.howToFix: Create skills for real jobs (like “create a session” or “stream audio”), with clear steps and links to the right docs.

checks.title: Explain how to get API keys
checks.howToFix: Write simple steps for getting a token or API key without needing a human-only UI.

checks.title: Add ready-to-paste prompts
checks.howToFix: On important tutorials, add a prompt box users can paste into Cursor or Claude.

checks.title: Add end-to-end guides
checks.howToFix: Publish cookbooks or quickstarts that walk through a full setup from start to finish.

categories.title: Trust and freshness
categories.description: Signals that content is current and consistent.

checks.title: Show versions or update dates
checks.howToFix: Show API versions, “last updated” dates, or release notes on important pages.

checks.title: Keep skill links up to date
checks.howToFix: Make sure every skill link still opens the correct live docs page.

checks.title: Publish a changelog
checks.howToFix: Add release notes or a changelog so people and AI tools know what changed.

checks.title: Keep guidance factual
checks.howToFix: When you correct AI mistakes, use facts and links — not marketing slogans.

checks.title: Use HTTPS
checks.howToFix: Serve your docs on https:// with one stable main domain.
